The '''2nd Wing Guard''' was a [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud car]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] assigned to the [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Wing Guard]]&mdash;a highly streamlined [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security force]] composed of [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] hired by [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] to help protect [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].

==History==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City's]] [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]], [[Dominic Raynor]], lost his administrative office to [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] in a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|Sabacc]]. Lando subsequently reorganized the existing airborne security force, [[1st Wing Guard]]&mdash;which was steeped in the corruption fostered by Raynor<ref name="BWGITDB" />&mdash;into the 2nd Wing Guard, made up of commando pilots hired by Calrissian. The best pilots from the 2nd Wing Guard were reassigned to [[Wing Guard Elite]],<ref name="Veteran">{{PocketModel|set=Scum & Villainy|cardname=Elite Wing Guard cloud car|link=https://www.starwars-universe.com/collectionnables-serie-356-scum-R-villainy.html#carte}}</ref> a special airborne unit formed out of the 1st and 2nd Wing Guard squadrons.<ref name="Veteran" /><ref name="SWPM" />

When [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] brought an occupation force to Cloud City, the 2nd Wing Guard became aligned with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] when [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]] and Lando orchestrated resistance against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces and Calrissian departed with members of the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="Empire" /><ref name="SWPM" />

==Description==
Based in [[Cloud City Security Tower]] on Bespin's Cloud City,<ref name="BWGITDB" /> the 2nd Wing Guard's [[Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car/Legends|cloud cars]] were painted [[Color/Legends|orange]] and offered minimal protection to the pilots who flew them.<ref name="SWPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 2nd Wing Guard was represented by a miniature in the ''[[Scum & Villainy]]'' expansion of the ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]''.<ref name="SWPM" />
